correctness.rationale: Derived outgoing edge derivatives from elementary solutions of -u''=k^2u: each adjacent backbone gives k(u_neighbor-u_j cos k)/sin k; one loop with equal endpoint values gives net 2k u_j tan(k/2). Kirchhoff sum reduces to u_(j+1)+u_(j-1)=2(2 cos k-1)u_j; Floquet real theta iff cos k>=0. At k=n*pi, zero vertex amplitudes yield exact sine-coefficient relation a_j-(-1)^n a_(j-1)+(1-(-1)^n)b_j=0. For even n, one loop sine is an eigenfunction; for odd n, choose a_0=1 and b_0=b_1=-1/2, rest zero; translated compact eigenfunctions are linearly independent. Nonnegative self-adjoint Kirchhoff Laplacian excludes E<0; periodic Floquet decomposition rules out nonresonant spectral remainder. Verified analytic recurrence and resonance balance directly; source verify.py contains limited floating checks, which are not used to infer spectrum completeness.

limitations: Only unit-length, standard Kirchhoff zero-phase zero-delta loop chain; no unequal lengths, magnetic coupling, spectral perturbations.
